findings.text: the baseline_suite and after_suite blocks state prose counts and log filenames but omit the contracted revision, command, exit_status, completed, failure_count and failure_ids fields, so the 18-to-19 delta is reported rather than reproducible from the suite records alone.

the status refusal is parametrized over three literal synonyms while the live fleet carries at least five more observed non-vocabulary words (working, reported, partial, shipped, in-progress-completing); a direct call shows each of those is refused and names the accepted vocabulary too, so this is a coverage gap rather than a behaviour gap.

the inverse control asserts a role changing no tracked path is not refused but names no path at all, so the report-only shape a writing role takes when its artefact lives outside its repository is untested; a constructed instance of it, a test role naming /tmp/gate-probe/reviews/out.json, was NOT GATED on a direct call, and it belongs in the file because it is the shape that separates writing from reporting.

no case asserts the order of the two refusals, so the fact that the review refusal now arrives before the verifier-source refusal for a test-role run committing a source path is pinned only by tests/test_crew_test_role.py, which still asserts the message the review refusal displaced.

item_verdicts.diff: read b650bbec against ee622294; it replaces the role-equality predicate with a written-repository predicate plus a second guard, and adds a 438-line test file.
item_verdicts.done_when: read the node manifest's evidence block and re-ran the guard myself rather than the tests; the measure is reachability, and chargeability holds: four writing-role shapes refused, four inverse controls green, a recognised status accepted and six non-vocabulary words refused by name.
item_verdicts.goal: read the node prompt's goal line and the plan's §2f; the goal is that the promotion review gate follow the writing rather than the role name, and a direct call to reckon/crew/promotion.py:2037 _require_review_waiver with a test, documentation and investigate record each naming a tracked path returns the scoring refusal in all three cases, so the goal is met where it was asked for.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md:1-22, and both commits' changed paths match the orientation_write_paths declared at manifest.md:3.
item_verdicts.write_paths: b650bbec touches exactly reckon/crew/promotion.py and tests/test_review_gate_coverage.py, and 6c53a757 touches the three declared docs paths, so the landed diff equals the declared scope.

justifications.durability: tests/test_review_gate_coverage.py holds 22 cases over 16 test functions and the guard sits on the only promotion route, reckon/cli.py:2909 into promotion.py:2149 and 2167, but no case pins that the review refusal precedes the verifier-source refusal and no case covers a writing role naming a path outside its repository.
justifications.evidence: the guard was called directly at the changed revision and returned the scoring refusal for all four writing shapes and NOT GATED for all four inverse controls, but manifest.md:16-17 state the suite delta as prose counts and log filenames rather than the contracted structured fields, so the delta is not reproducible from the suite records alone.
justifications.fit: the two guards are named by mechanism, _require_review_waiver and _require_recognised_manifest_status, promotion.py:2037 and 2005, they reuse the existing _changed_paths_inside_repository seam rather than adding one, and the test file carries no plan or stage identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion.py:2063-2068 keys on _manifest_repository_paths rather than the role literal, and direct calls show test, documentation, investigate and role-less records each naming a tracked path are all refused while the review role stays exempt.
justifications.scope_discipline: b650bbec contains exactly the two declared source paths and 6c53a757 exactly the three declared docs paths, with no undeclared or generated file.
